verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report confirms that Gitea has a built-in repository mirroring feature, used to keep local copies of followed upstream projects. That covers the 'from another Git server' (pull mirror) direction. No first-party documentation in the pack describes mirroring, and nothing shows push mirroring to another server or branch-level mirroring. Missing for 10: first-party mirroring docs, push mirroring to external Git servers, branch-level mirror configuration, sync scheduling and credential details.
